description: This Java class, Animation1, is an Android activity that demonstrates the use of view animations. It sets a click listener on a login button, and upon clicking, applies a shake animation to a password field.

classes.name: Animation1
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating view animation upon button click.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and assigns a click listener to the login button.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events; loads and applies a shake animation to a view with ID 'pw'.
